notes: Very long CV (Nov 2025): kept refereed articles and book chapters; skipped op-eds, comments, reviews, white papers, non-refereed P&P, encyclopedia entries, some chapters, a World Bank report, and the 2022 RFS mortgage paper (CV says retracted Jan 2025). CV gives many articles without a year: those years are inferred from CV order (esp. 2017-2025 items) and may be off; items 161-173 have no status in CV, marked published. For 'joint with' entries authors = Kahn + named coauthors sorted by surname unless CV gave a full byline; some coauthor names are surname-only and some entries ('multiple coauthors', none named) list only Kahn, so author lists may be incomplete. Working papers: 8 from homepage 'New Research as of September 2026' (no coauthors/years shown; year 2026 = page date; authors Kahn only, likely incomplete) plus 2 CV working papers (year = CV date 2025).
